def fit_ranker(X, y, n_groups, k, lr, random_state):
    import lightgbm as lgb
    model = lgb.LGBMRanker(objective='lambdarank', metric='ndcg', lambdarank_truncation_level=k, boosting_type='gbdt', max_depth=3, num_leaves=7, min_child_samples=20, learning_rate=float(lr) / 2, n_estimators=200 * 2, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.8, reg_lambda=1.0, n_jobs=1, random_state=int(random_state), verbosity=-1, deterministic=True, force_row_wise=True)
    model.fit(X, y, group=np.full(n_groups, k, dtype=np.int32), eval_at=[1, k])
    return model
